title: Switch Down Payment for a Move off Automatic Draft — Installment Payment Plans Desk Reference
content:
**Subject.** Under the **Installment Payment Plans**, when the named insured of an Owner Auto Policy term billed on the Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan or the Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan asks to move the plan off automatic draft to the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan, the move requires a switch down payment, taken by a one-time card or bank payment the named insured authorizes. The switch down payment is recorded on the plan toward the first installment not yet invoiced (carrying that installment's number) and linked to no invoice; it is taken off the premium the move spreads again; and it is never applied to an invoice already issued.

**Limits.** A switch down payment is due only where neither the installment invoice that the payment most recently returned on the plan had paid nor its next installment invoice, if already issued, has two or more payments posted against it (a payment recorded against an invoice not counting when it is the returned payment itself or a makeup referencing it), and the owner term backs at most one certificate. When the move is asked on any other plan, or outside these limits, no switch down payment is due (the figure is 0.00).

**Authorization.** For a switch down payment, the named insured authorizes the payment personally by running it with the representative, choosing the payment method and confirming the amount the representative states.

## The payment function: `authorize_switch_down_payment_5d76e7dc`

**Capability.** Through `authorize_switch_down_payment_5d76e7dc` the named insured personally authorizes a one-time payment, taken today by a representative over the phone, that pays the down payment a move of the installment payment plan to another payment plan requires. On success a payment for the authorized amount is posted to the plan today through the representative phone channel, recorded toward the stated installment and linked to no invoice and to no endorsement; the plan's account balance falls by the amount; and a payment confirmation number is issued to the customer.

**How it is invoked.** It is the customer's own tool: the representative unlocks `authorize_switch_down_payment_5d76e7dc` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `billing_plan_id` | The reference number of the installment payment plan that receives the payment, read from the plan record returned by the plan lookup. |
| `installment_number` | The number of the first installment not yet invoiced on the plan, toward which the payment is recorded: an integer of 0 or more, installments counted from 1 for the plan's earliest installment, no padding. |
| `payment_method` | How the customer pays, exactly one of: `debit_card` — the customer pays with a debit card they hold and state; `credit_card` — the customer pays with a credit card they hold and state; `bank_ach` — the customer pays from a checking or savings account they hold, by routing and account number; `personal_check` — a paper check the customer has mailed or handed in, never one taken over the phone; `money_order` — a money order the customer has mailed or handed in, never one taken over the phone; `cashiers_check` — a cashier's check the customer has mailed or handed in, never one taken over the phone; `cash` — cash handed in at an agent office, never one taken over the phone. |
| `amount` | The amount the customer authorizes, in USD with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent. |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence stating the payment confirmation number (PMT- followed by ten digits), the payment reference number, the amount (USD, two decimals), the method, the posting date (YYYY-MM-DD) and the plan's account balance after the payment (USD, two decimals). The confirmation number indicates the payment was accepted and posted.
